evidence: Adds a new BaseIndex implementation under src/index/ (txoscriptindex) and extends txospenderindex.
rationale: Introduces a major optional index resolving a long-standing demand dating back to 2013 across multiple closed PRs (#2802, #3652, #6835, #10370, #14053). Reviewers have validated that it indexes efficiently on pruned nodes and allows fast lookups for external tooling without heavy third-party stacks.
